name: subagent
description: Delegate a task to a subagent with your full tool set. Use it when the work would flood this conversation with tool output, when independent pieces can run in parallel, or for a side investigation. Coding goes here too with dev=true. The subagent starts from a fresh context, so prompt must stand on its own: background, conclusions you already confirmed, the goal, and what it should return. It always runs in the background: you are woken with its final message when its whole task finishes. It may delegate one level further, no deeper.

description.description: Short label, used for progress display.

prompt.description: The complete task prompt. The subagent sees nothing of this conversation, so include the background, the constraints and what to report back.

dev.description: Development mode: the dev system prompt plus a minimal coding tool set. Turn it on for every coding task and put the whole job, files and directories included, in prompt.

max_steps.description: Cap on tool-call steps. Unlimited by default.

tier.description: Model tier by difficulty: lite for trivial lookups, cheap for simple tool work, standard (default) for regular multi-step work, flagship for hard reasoning. Every tier has the full tool set; an unconfigured one falls back to the main model.

session_id.description: Continue an existing subagent by the session id from a previous result, or by a background job_id: queued as a follow-up if it is still running, otherwise a new turn there.

resume_id.description: Resume a run that failed with a resume_id in its error.
